steps.description: Identify cities known for excellent air quality suitable for a weekend getaway.
Select a city from the identified list that fits the weekend getaway criteria.
required_inputs: list of cities with excellent air quality

steps.description: Find available accommodation options and best hotel deals in the selected city for the weekend.
Retrieve popular tourist attractions and activities in the selected city.
Fetch the current air quality index and weather forecast for the selected city during the weekend.
